_meta.scope: Deals tab: Type G validation of shipped opportunities (ANPI, Janus, DOE pilot, DOME, Eielson, Equinix-Radiant, Oklo-Switch, NANO, Last Energy, Canada); Type N search for buyer deals dated after 2026-10-30 that skip/news.json lacks.
angles_run: Army Janus vendor and site assignments (army.mil fetch)
Air Force ANPI JBSA, Buckley, Malmstrom status and NRC contingency (ANS fetch)
Eielson NOITA status (Oklo release fetch; eielson.af.mil did not resolve)
Last Energy Thames Freeport vs Llynfi site scope (ONR fetch)
Saskatchewan Research Council eVinci status (SRC FAQ and Legislative Assembly Hansard fetches)
DOE Reactor Pilot Program criticality count and Deployable Unity date (ANS fetch)
NANO Nuclear x Supermicro MOU date (search only)
Oklo x Switch master agreement binding status (search only)
Radiant, Valar, Aalo, Deep Fission new buyer deals after 2026-10-30 (search only)
Texas A&M RELLIS SMR lead from skip/web-leads.md (search only)
absences: No buyer deal (PPA, MOU, LOI, contract or site selection) dated after 2026-10-30 found in fetched or search-summary results, so no items were written.
Oklo x Switch: no 2026 source found showing any individual binding PPA. Only SEC 10-Q excerpts and forecasting pages were reachable; not checked against an Oklo 8-K.
Eielson: no source found after June 2025 showing a contract signed. eielson.af.mil did not resolve; the check relies on the Oklo release.
Army Janus: the 'negotiating' status of the Other Transactions agreements was not confirmed by a fetched page, so no check was written for the shipped status text.
DOE Reactor Pilot Program: no sixth criticality found in search; sources disagree on the count reached by the 2026-07-04 deadline.
NANO x Supermicro: MOU date of 2026-05-06 seen only in search summaries (primary is ir.nanonuclearenergy.com release); not fetched.
Texas A&M RELLIS SMR lead (skip/web-leads.md, 2026-11-02): NRC page shows pre-application status; no permitting-stage news found. Not a buyer deal.
Radiant x Centrus HALEU contract (Sept 2026) appears in search summaries only and is a fuel deal, not a buyer deal; left to the news lane.
